nvlabs_detach_option: dora_simple defaults True; False retains the norm gradient.
paper_full_gradient: Section 4.2 equation 6 contains the direction-orthogonal projection.
paper_detached_gradient: Section 4.3 equation 11 replaces it with m/C times upstream gradient. Paper explicitly says all subsequent experiments incorporate this adjustment.
axis_conclusion: For torch.nn.Linear weights shaped [out,in], current dim=1 agrees with the authors and PEFT. Paper says column normalization in its notation; the literal word column alone is insufficient to select a PyTorch storage dimension.
detach_conclusion: Documented optional memory-saving gradient choice, not a correction of an invalid full-gradient DoRA formula.
